The '''DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret''' was a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turret used on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

==Description==
[[File:TiptoeThruTheTurrets-RotS.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] passing by DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]]
The DBY-827 was the standard requirement in naval gunnery around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] for inter-ship combat and [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] bombardment. Each turret was mounted with powerful tracking sensors as well as a large power capacitor which quickly discharged energy to the guns. ''Venators'' had eight DBY-827s. During close-range fights, the turret could rotate in three seconds with its fast-tracking mode.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

The DBY-827 had seven different intensity settings. This allowed the ''Venator's'' [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] to select a range of destruction, from a small strike to a vaporizing blow. As a true [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] could divert almost all of its reactor output to its heavy turbolasers.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" />

[[File:VenatorCannons.png|thumb|right|250px|DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turrets of a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]

==History==
The Star Destroyer [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] made effective use of these turbolasers in the battle against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle over Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', these turrets seem to take the form of [[Beam cannon turret/Legends|beam cannon turrets]] rather than turbolasers, though this is probably game mechanics.

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'' and its [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]], these turrets appear in Episode III Chapter I. When shot, they spin around and give studs.
